summary: Cerebral Physique has progressed into a membership-gated content + commerce platform on ICP: backend-managed public blog rendering (with per-post gating), a Stripe-powered recurring membership checkout flow (success/failure handling and user membership status), an Amazon Affiliate Store storefront with admin CRUD, an expanded Creator/Admin dashboard to manage these areas, and backend upgrade persistence/migration infrastructure—while maintaining the hard constraint of ZERO email functionality.
architectural_notes: Frontend uses TanStack Router for client-side routing with a single root layout (Header/Outlet/Footer).
Backend is a single Motoko canister actor with in-memory Map stores for exercises, breathwork, routines, user profiles, and blog posts.
Role-based access control implemented via an AccessControl module and a MixinAuthorization mixin; admin is assigned via a secret token compared against an environment variable.
Frontend data access is centralized via custom React Query hooks (useQueries.ts) with cache invalidation on mutations.
Actor instantiation is abstracted behind useActor, which recreates the backend actor when Internet Identity changes and reinitializes authorization.
UI is built with Tailwind CSS (OKLCH design tokens) and reusable components (buttons, cards, dialogs, tables), plus subtle animated hero backgrounds.
Global music playback state is handled with Zustand and an HTMLAudioElement wrapper (useMusicPlayer).
URL secret handling exists for admin token retrieval from hash fragment with sessionStorage persistence and hash cleanup.
Canister includes optional infrastructure helpers: IC HTTP outcalls wrapper and Caffeine blob-storage gateway/GC mixin.
Hard constraint: platform must include ZERO email functionality (no receipts, confirmations, welcome emails, or automations).
known_issues: AccessControl.getUserRole traps for authenticated-but-unregistered principals; the design relies on calling _initializeAccessControlWithSecret at actor creation time to avoid this.
There appear to be two different CSS files shown (frontend/src/index.css and frontend/index.css) which may indicate duplication/config confusion in the repo/build pipeline.
Environment variable spelling mismatch in storage module (CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL has an extra 'F'); misconfiguration would trap at runtime.
Background music points to /assets/ambient-music.mp3 but the hook comments imply the file may not exist; playback will fail silently or be blocked by autoplay policies.
Routine add/remove endpoints do not validate that provided IDs actually exist in the exercise/breathwork stores, allowing routines to reference deleted/missing items.
WorkoutLibraryPage eagerly issues six muscle-group queries plus all-exercises query, which may be unnecessarily chatty on slow networks (prefetch pattern).
Creator/admin editing entry point is not reliably discoverable ("Creator Dashboard" button reportedly missing on desktop).
Workout Library data often fails to seed/load (muscle group cards show 0 exercises / infinite loading), indicating a backend seeding/query or routing/display issue.
Stripe integration depends on IC HTTP outcalls and correct environment/secret configuration; misconfiguration or insufficient cycles can cause checkout/membership operations to fail.

existing_features.title: Marketing website pages and navigation
existing_features.description: Implements Home, About, Programs, Blog, Contact, and Workout Library pages with a shared Layout (Header/Footer) and TanStack Router routes.

existing_features.title: Workout library browsing by muscle group
existing_features.description: Displays collapsible muscle-group sections that query and render exercises, including media (video/image), equipment type, difficulty badges, instructions, and benefits formatting.

existing_features.title: Breathwork practice library (Breathwork Station)
existing_features.description: Lists breathwork practices with technique description, benefits, duration, difficulty, and optional pairing display with recommended exercises.

existing_features.title: Personal routine creation and management
existing_features.description: Authenticated users can create a routine and add/remove both exercises and breathwork practices; routine view groups saved items and supports removal.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication integration
existing_features.description: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider with login/logout, identity persistence, delegation validity checks, and status flags used throughout the app.

existing_features.title: Backend actor creation and authorization initialization
existing_features.description: useActor creates an anonymous or authenticated canister actor, reads an admin secret from the URL hash, calls backend _initializeAccessControlWithSecret, and invalidates/refetches dependent React Query caches when identity changes.

existing_features.title: Role-based access control (admin/user/guest)
existing_features.description: Motoko AccessControl assigns roles (first valid token caller becomes admin; others become users), enforces permissions on admin/user endpoints, and exposes isCallerAdmin/getCallerUserRole/assignCallerUserRole.

existing_features.title: Admin-only Creator Dashboard
existing_features.description: Provides an admin-gated dashboard page with tabs for managing exercises, breathwork practices, and blog posts; non-admin users are denied access.

existing_features.title: Exercise CRUD management (admin)
existing_features.description: Admin UI for adding/editing/deleting exercises with validation, media/image previews, benefits editing, and table listing; backend endpoints persist exercises and maintain muscle-group associations.

existing_features.title: Breathwork practice CRUD management with exercise pairings (admin)
existing_features.description: Admin UI for creating/editing/deleting breathwork practices with validation, image preview, and selecting recommended exercise pairings; backend stores practices and metadata including duration and difficulty.

existing_features.title: Blog post CRUD and publishing workflow (admin + public filtering)
existing_features.description: Admin can create/edit/delete blog posts, publish/unpublish posts, and set SEO metadata; backend getAllBlogPosts returns only published posts for non-admin callers, while admins see all posts.

existing_features.title: User profile storage and music preference setting
existing_features.description: Backend supports saving caller profile and updating music preference; frontend provides React Query hooks for fetching/saving the current user's profile and updating preference.

existing_features.title: Global background music toggle
existing_features.description: Implements a global play/pause control in the Header backed by a Zustand store and an HTMLAudioElement with volume support and autoplay-policy error handling.

existing_features.title: Infrastructure helpers: HTTP outcalls and Caffeine blob-storage mixin
existing_features.description: Backend includes reusable modules for IC HTTP GET/POST (with transform) and a storage mixin for managing authorized gateway principals, dead blob cleanup, and cycle refills via a cashier canister.

existing_features.title: Stripe membership checkout flow (recurring subscription) with success/failure handling (no email)
existing_features.description: Implements Stripe-based recurring membership purchase flow, including a start-checkout button and dedicated Payment Success/Failure pages; avoids any email receipts/notifications in-app.

existing_features.title: Membership status dashboard and access gating hooks
existing_features.description: Adds a User Dashboard experience that surfaces membership status and supports gating for member-only content areas (e.g., blog posts/library) with clear upgrade CTAs.

existing_features.title: Public blog renders backend-managed posts with per-post pages and gating support
existing_features.description: Replaces hard-coded blog samples with backend-driven posts, including a dedicated blog-post page and support for member-only visibility/preview behavior while retaining admin publish/unpublish workflows.

existing_features.title: Amazon Affiliate Store storefront with disclosure and off-site checkout
existing_features.description: Adds an Affiliate Store page that lists curated product cards and routes users off-site to Amazon via stored affiliate links, with required affiliate disclosure on the store page.

existing_features.title: Admin CRUD for Amazon Affiliate Store products
existing_features.description: Adds Creator Dashboard management UI for affiliate products (create/edit/delete, images, categories, links) with storefront reflecting changes.

existing_features.title: Backend upgrade persistence and migration scaffolding
existing_features.description: Introduces backend migration/stable-persistence mechanisms so key data can survive canister upgrades, with migration support to preserve existing content.

existing_features.title: Make Workout Library muscle-group cards editable by admins so each muscle group card can display admin-managed image and text content (e.g., cover image and description) instead of relying only on hardcoded front-end mappings.

Update the Workout Library editing flow so admins can add/update per-exercise media and text content in a practical way for regular updates, including support for externally hosted image/video URLs (not only /assets/* paths).

Ensure the Blog section is clearly editable by admins for regularly adding and updating articles, using the existing blog management workflow (create/edit/publish/unpublish/delete) and making it easy to find from the Blog area.

new_feature_requests.summary: Membership-gated exercise video library: card-based muscle-group navigation with ~25 exercises per group; each exercise includes video, equipment type, primary/secondary muscles, and execution cues; supports safe/legal video sources (embeds/licensed/AI/original).
Admin controls for exercise library: add/remove muscle groups; add/edit/remove/reorder exercises; replace videos; edit descriptions and metadata.
Blog system (no email): admin CMS-style create/edit/publish/unpublish; support member-only posts and public previews.

Membership & access control with recurring billing (no email): secure sign-up/login, monthly subscription (default $19.99 admin-adjustable), immediate access on payment success, revoke access on failed payment, user dashboard shows membership status.

Payments & payouts (no email): PCI-compliant card checkout for subscriptions; payouts deposited to connected business bank account; admin dashboard shows transaction history/revenue without invoices/receipts via email.

Amazon Affiliate Store section: curated product cards (image/name/description/category/CTA) that redirect to Amazon via affiliate links; include required affiliate disclosure; admin can manage products, images, categories, and links.
Unified Admin Dashboard (no email tooling): manage users/memberships, view payments/revenue, manage blog content, manage exercise library, manage affiliate products, adjust subscription pricing.
UX/design update for premium mindful fitness: clean card-based layouts, mobile-optimized, fast-loading video embeds, clear CTAs (Unlock the Library/Become a Member/Shop on Amazon).

Remove all email-related UI, copy, and behaviors across the app (including any newsletter/email signup forms, “delivered to your inbox” copy, and any simulated email submission flows) and ensure the platform operates with ZERO email functionality.

Implement a monthly subscription membership system (default price $19.99/month, admin-adjustable) that unlocks full exercise library access and full blog access, with a user dashboard showing current membership status.

Add PCI-compliant payment processing for recurring monthly subscriptions using credit/debit cards, including checkout flow and subscription lifecycle handling (active, past_due/unpaid, canceled), with payouts deposited to the connected business bank account, and with NO invoices/receipts or any email flows generated by the app.

Gate the exercise video library so that only active members can view full exercise details and video demonstrations; non-members should see a limited preview state with clear CTAs (“Unlock the Library”, “Become a Member”).

Refactor the exercise library data model and UI to match required muscle groups and exercise metadata: Chest, Back, Shoulders, Biceps, Triceps, Legs (Quads/Hamstrings/Glutes/Calves), Core/Abs; each exercise must include name, video demonstration, equipment type (machine/dumbbell/cable/bodyweight), primary + secondary muscles, and short-form execution cues.

Add admin controls to fully manage the exercise library structure and ordering: add/remove muscle groups, add/edit/remove exercises, replace videos, edit all metadata/descriptions, and reorder exercise cards within a group.

Ensure video handling supports safe/legal sources by supporting externally hosted embeds (e.g., YouTube/Vimeo/private CDN URLs) and/or direct video URLs, and add validation/UX guidance in admin tools to discourage illegal scraping/downloading.

Expand the Admin Dashboard to include dedicated sections for: managing users and memberships, viewing payments/revenue and transaction history, controlling blog content, controlling the exercise library, controlling affiliate store products, and adjusting subscription pricing; do not include any email settings/tools.

Update the overall UX to a premium fitness and mindset-focused, clean card-based, mobile-optimized experience with fast-loading video embeds and clear CTAs (“Unlock the Library”, “Become a Member”, “Shop on Amazon”) applied consistently across gated areas and the affiliate store.
Rename the main navigation/storefront label from "Store" to "Cerebral shop" (Amazon Affiliate Store entry point).

Make Workout Library muscle-group cards and exercises fully editable via admin/creator tools so the owner can regularly add/update per-exercise media (images and/or video clips), text/content, and other featured details; also ensure Blog section is editable for regularly adding/updating blog articles.
